now: Detective Eddy Costa, who held his own gun to his head that day, had nightmares about it until Kilgrave died, and offers to work with Jessica.
fix: Detective Eddy Costa, who held his own gun to his head that day, had nightmares about it until Kilgrave died, and offers to work with Jessica.
why: Costa's own wiki page (fetched myself) says he first appears in JJ202, and he tells Jessica about the nightmares of holding his gun to his head, and that they stopped the day she killed Kilgrave, in JJ205 'AKA The Octopus' (Jessica Jones S2). He is not in S1 at all. Kilgrave dies at the end of S1, so this line can only be revealed in S2. If it showed after S1 it would sit on the wrong title (D2), and seen during S1 it would give away Kilgrave's death. It is the only fall line with no title, so it does not match the [text, title] shape. Adding the title 'Jessica Jones S2', which the app's data already uses, is the smallest fix and leaves the text as it is.

now: Loss lines cover Happy Hogan, Sharon Carter, Kurt, Okoye, Bucky Barnes, Vision and most of humanity, but not Hope van Dyne.
fix: Add a loss line: ["Hope van Dyne, wounded and infected on the way to Camp Lehigh.", "What If...?"]
why: Hope van Dyne is one of the survivor group and dies on the way in. On the train she blows up the infected Sharon Carter and is wounded in the blast. The infection spreads, and when the train stops outside Camp Lehigh she grows giant to carry the group through the horde, then dies and later comes back as a zombie. Wikipedia lists her with Hogan and Carter as lost to zombie attacks on the way there. The other survivors' losses are all listed, so leaving her out is a real omission. The proposed line is true, uses the [text, title] shape, and is tied to the right title. It is kind missing, so it does not count toward the owner's wrong-only bar.

now: John King, suffocated in a sealed greenhouse.
fix: John King, suffocated in a sealed greenhouse.
why: John's death is tied to the wrong title. A bare string got in when an earlier accepted amend (dc/accepted.json n 24) wrote only the text into loss:1. In index.html, dcLines = L => L.filter(([, t]) => atlSeenT(t)) destructures the string, so t becomes 'o', its second character. 'o' is not a title, so the line never unlocks and never shows. Ironheart episode 3 confirms the fact: in the Heirlum heist, N.A.T.A.L.I.E. rescues Riri and John is left to suffocate. So pairing the line with 'Ironheart' is the right fix and the smallest one.

Forget everything you think you know.' to Karl Mordo, said to Stephen Strange in Doctor Strange (film). That line does not appear on the Doctor_Strange/Quote or Wong/Quote pages. So a character box for Doctor Strange & Wong gives the line to the wrong character, which is a real attribution error under S7. The proposed replacement, 'Dormammu, I've come to bargain.', is on the Doctor_Strange/Quote page as Doctor Strange's line to Dormammu in Doctor Strange (film). It is Strange's own on-screen line and does not reveal how the film ends.
